definitions.AMBIGUOUS: cannot be decided from the string alone whether the name carries warrant or names an object
definitions.ATTRIBUTION: the prose credits a specific result, theorem or claim to a named source or person AS ITS WARRANT - the reader is being told the claim is true because that authority established it
definitions.MENTION: the named term is used as the STANDARD NAME of a standard object; whatever is asserted is asserted by srmech, not by a source
definitions.term_status.PHANTOM: the match is a MATCHER ARTIFACT - a whitespace-joined cross-word accident, or the term inside a code identifier
definitions.term_status.REAL: the matched manifest term occurs as prose
